how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_090.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

Centipedes are fast, speed-oriented insects that can escape virtually any fight. Their many legs makes up for their lack of power.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.chaos_doll: The result of an Arch Doll reversing its alignment to become Chaos aligned.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.chaos_meta: The result of a Chaos Doll  achieving Divinity and awakening.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.charged_pe: A rare mutation of a sculk worm. It consumed essence of Lightning itself and gained specific abilities. But this one... Seems weird.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.cherub.des: The second most powerful type of pure Angel known.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.daemon_dol: The result of an Arch Doll acquiring a name.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.darkness_f: A Direwolf that has a connection to the dark. It can blend in with the shadows and become invisible, as dark as night.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.devil_doll: The result of a Daemon Doll achieving Divinity and awakening.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.direwolf.d: Direwolves are a species of monster that love to cause havoc. The more intelligent and friendly ones are capable of giving others a ride on their back. They have great potential for growth.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.dissonance: What was once a sculk worm has truly disappeared. "The beast stretched from one horizon to the next and belched storms that reminded all of the hero’s promise: that this land – and all those who live here - would never suffer again..." It has achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_arm: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Army Wasp that has gained Divinity.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_dro: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Drone Beetle that has gained Divinity.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_ele: An aspect of perfection that embodies its element to perfection. This being possesses God-level Spiritual Magic rivaling King-Tier Ultimate Skills that can wipe out continents should they be cast.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_exc: The culmination of one who has lost their past. They find meaning in their new life, pushing past all their worries and transgressions to attain Divinity.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_fir: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Fire Ant that has gained Divinity.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_har: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Hardshell Ant that has gained Divinity.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_inf: The culmination of one who has lost their past. They find meaning in death, defeating all, even one who has truly forgotten the world, just to attain Divinity.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_lix: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Lixivant Mantis that has gained Divinity.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_lox: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Loxodrome Scorpion that has gained Divinity.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_maj: An aspect of perfection that embodies its element to perfection. This being possesses God-level Spiritual Magic rivaling King-Tier Ultimate Skills that can wipe out continents should they be cast.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_pre: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Preying Mantis that has gained Divinity.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_pur: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Purple Centipede that has gained Divinity.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_que: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Queen Wasp that has gained Divinity.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_sin: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Singularity Scorpion that has gained Divinity.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_sta: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Stag Beetle that has gained Divinity.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_ten: The result of a Tengu achieving Divinity.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_wol: Direwolf that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.divine_yel: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Yellow Centipede that has gained Divinity.
A child of the stars and hopes of the world. Can you obtain true power? You can only ever evolve once, but your stats grow with your EP.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.drone_beet: An evolved beetle, leaning into its speed. Trading damage for speed, it is now capable of flight. However, it is still too young.
A Drone Beetle that has gained a humanoid body. Its wings are much stronger and capable of traveling much quicker.
A Drone Beetle that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It flies at tremendous speeds, almost capable of breaking the sound barrier with how fast it flies.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.earth_soul: A Hardshell Ant that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It embodies the element of Earth perfectly, defending the weak and fighting off those who wrong it.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.elemental_: A graceful and elegant evolved Elemental that wields powerful Lord-level Spiritual Magic, capable of going toe-to-toe with Ultimate Skills.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.empty.desc: A Remnant that chose the hard way out. Instead of accepting their forgotten past, they chose to fight it, to no avail. A greater, emptier husk awaits.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.enflamed_a: These creatures have evolved to look eerily similar to their overworld counterparts. Pray that its power is not truly unleashed. It is a demi-spiritual lifeform.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.fallen.des: A seraph that got corrupted by magicules, then chose to abandon the light for the darkness.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.fallen_arc: An arch angel that got corrupted by magicules, despite that, they still retain the light element.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.fallen_che: A cherub that got corrupted by magicules, despite that, they still retain the light element.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.fallen_gre: A greater angel that got corrupted by magicules, despite that, they still retain the light element.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.fallen_les: A lesser angel that got corrupted by magicules, despite that, they still retain the light element.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.fallen_lor: A cherub that got corrupted by magicules, then chose to abandon the light for the darkness.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.fallen_ser: A seraph that got corrupted by magicules, despite that, they still retain the light element.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.fantasy_so: A Stag Beetle that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It embodies the element of Fantasy perfectly, distorting magic and removing threats with pure might alone.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.field_offi: The evolution of a Phantom with an ego, now having the ability to split bodies.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.fire_ant.d: An evolved ant, leaning into its offenses. They are able to ignite their physical attacks, akin to the Fire Aspect enchantment.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.fire_ant_i: A Fire Ant that has gained a humanoid body. It delivers painful, stinging bites and fights ferociously.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.fire_ant_s: A Fire Ant that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It carries out the will of the army, being a shining beacon for other Fire Ants.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.flame_soul: A Fire Ant that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It embodies the element of Flames perfectly, singing its foes to a fiery demise.
The Forgotten Race struggle to remember. A ghost, an apparition of something that used to be. The remains of a soul from someone long departed, that couldn’t be reused in reincarnation. Left behind to linger the world eternally.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.frost_wolf: A Direwolf that has a connection to ice. Temperatures drop to lethal freezing points when one exists nearby.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.frostcoil_: A sea dragon race that lives in the coldest depths of the Ocean's tundra's, using its enhanced ears to find its prey, and its speed to catch them.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.frostwroug: A deadly dragon that lives near the bottom of the ocean's, a tame but deadly race able to manipulate sound to find and catch threads.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.gale_spiri: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Black Fangs bow to this creature.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.general.de: A commanding officer of the Phantom army.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.glacier_sp: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Frost Wolves bow to this creature.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.greater_an: The evolution of a Lesser Angel with a more developed ego.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.greater_do: The result of a Greater Daemon possessing a magisteel body.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.greater_el: An Elemental that evolved to take on a more human-like shape. Beware its powerful Greater Spiritual Magic!
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.greater_fa: A greater angel that got corrupted by magicules, then chose to abandon the light for the darkness.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.greater_gl: A higher evolution of the wyrm that live in the Icy Tundras, even more powerful and deadly then their previous evolutions, using its icy breath to freeze all those who come across it.A higher evolution of the wyrm that live in the Icy Tundras, even more powerful and deadly then their previous evolutions, using its icy breath to freeze all those who come across it.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.greater_py: A higher evolution of the wyrm that lives in the deserts, using its flaming breath to scorch its preys as it hunts those unprepared for the heat.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.green_fang: A Direwolf that has a connection to wind. It can tune in to the nearby magicules and use it to sense its surroundings.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.guitar_wol: A Direwolf that has a connection to sound. It can tune in to the nearby magicules and use it to sense its surroundings.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.hardshell_: An evolved ant, leaning into its defenses. They naturally have good bulk, making them extremely tough to take out of a fight.
A Hardshell Ant that has gained a humanoid body. Its shell has only become tougher, and it will continue to become stronger.
A Hardshell Ant that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It carries out the will of the army, being a shining beacon for other Hardshell Ants.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.insect.des: A cryptid from another world. They excel in physical combat, and specialise in different things. Which one will you be? (Selecting this will RE-ROLL your race among the races in the Mysticism General config file!)
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.lesser_ang: A spiritual life-form similar to Daemons known to wreck havoc on the world every 500 years.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.lesser_ele: A curious Elemental with a mind not yet formed. What shape will it take?
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.lesser_fal: A lesser angel that got corrupted by magicules, then chose to abandon the light for the darkness.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.lesser_gla: A Race of Wyrm that live in the depth of the Icy Tundras, thriving on the cold and all those live in it.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.lesser_pyr: A race of wyrm that live hottest deserts, thriving on the heat and all those that live in it.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.light_fang: A Direwolf that has a connection to the light. It blinds its prey before striking.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.lightning_: Pray that its power is not truly unleashed. Know the fear and drive behind an aberration of pure electricity. It is a demi-spiritual lifeform.
A Drone Beetle that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It embodies the element of Lightning perfectly, rupturing the battlefield and being nigh untouchable.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.lixivant_m: An evolved mantis, gaining the ability to corrode things. It melts through enemy defenses and cripples them before they even know what hit them.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.loxodrome_: An evolved scorpion, becoming the king of the pack. It uses deadly and lethal venom to destroy all of its targets from the inside.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.magic_spir: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Black Fangs bow to this creature.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.magma_worm: "And his brother loved worms..." A powerful evolved variant of the sculk worm, gaining a long, worm-like appendage.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.majin_lord: A very powerful majinised Elemental that wields powerful Lord-level Spiritual Magic, capable of going toe-to-toe with Ultimate Skills.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.mantis.des: Mantises are fast-hitting insects that whittle down their opponents with quick strikes and their powerful melee skills. Some variants have even been known to melt through armor.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.medium_ele: An Elemental that has evolved, taking the form of a mythological creature. Its arsenal of Spiritual Magic is now stronger as well.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.molten_per: A rare mutation of a sculk worm achieved through forcibly devouring Flame Essence. Now it thrives in the Nether.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.molten_spi: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Scorch Wolves bow to this creature.
